description: Green University of Bangladesh publishes degradation observations for forty photovoltaic modules exposed outdoors for four years on a five-storey building in Mirpur, Dhaka. The Harvard Dataverse resource provides an unrestricted Excel workbook under CC0, published in August 2024. It reports voltage, current, power and fill factor under stated test conditions, together with image-based indications of defects such as hotspots, microcracks and dust. These site-specific measurements can calibrate PV ageing and maintenance simulations for tropical environments. The sample is limited to one installation and module exposure history, so it does not establish degradation rates for every panel technology. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: A dataset of four years old PV modules under outdoor test conditions in Dhaka Bangladesh
notes: G4-0312; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
